channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight a severe concentration of remote code execution, authentication bypasses, and path traversal flaws across web security, network devices, and cloud infrastructure. Widely deployed platforms including the WordPress ecosystem, Mitel and Dell networking gear, and major cloud providers like Google and Red Hat face critical exploitation risks that enable unauthenticated system takeover and privilege escalation. The threat landscape is further compounded by insecure deserialization and buffer overflow vulnerabilities affecting industrial control systems, mail servers, and core operating components, underscoring an urgent need for immediate patching across enterprise and consumer deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-137941 — Desktop OS
item.description: Heap out-of-bounds read/write via crafted XCF files allows arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2026-132876 — Desktop OS
item.description: Dependency on a vulnerable third-party component enables remote code execution under the current user context.

item.title: CVE-2026-137457 — Desktop OS
item.description: Missing authentication in RDP fast-path input handlers allows unauthenticated attackers to inject keystrokes and mouse events before session activation.

item.title: CVE-2026-137994 — Desktop OS
item.description: Insecure deserialization of embedded pickle data in XML attributes leads to arbitrary code execution in the Leo editor.

item.title: CVE-2026-118137 — Desktop OS
item.description: The Windows FTP Service suffers from improper authorization that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally, directly impacting enterprise desktop security postures.

item.title: CVE-2026-137939 — Desktop OS
item.description: The Sparkle macOS updater contains a symlink following vulnerability during cache operations, which could enable local attackers to overwrite arbitrary system files during legitimate software updates.

item.title: CVE-2026-137738 — Desktop OS
item.description: Unauthenticated UDP exploitation in RealVNC Server enables remote code execution as root or denial of service across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms. This poses a critical threat to remote desktop infrastructure relying on legacy transport protocols.

item.title: CVE-2026-133842 — Desktop OS
item.description: A permission canonicalization failure in Flatpak’s system helper allows privilege escalation during runtime installations when deeply nested directory trees trigger resource limits. This undermines desktop sandboxing guarantees and package manager security.

item.title: CVE-2026-133845 — Desktop OS
item.description: Improper handling of failed file descriptor duplication in the Flatpak portal breaks application sandbox isolation, potentially exposing host filesystem resources to confined apps. This flaw weakens containerization boundaries on modern Linux desktops.

item.title: CVE-2026-136548 — IoT Security
item.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in hostname handling allows remote code execution; a public exploit is already available.

item.title: CVE-2026-136553 — IoT Security
item.description: Improper authentication in the Wi-Fi setup routine enables remote unauthorized network configuration and device takeover.

item.title: CVE-2022-50691 — IoT Security
item.description: Unauthenticated remote command execution via a GET parameter grants full root-level system access to the device.

item.title: CVE-2012-10033 — IoT Security
item.description: Remote code execution via an unsanitized release parameter passed to PHP's passthru function during image configuration workflows.

item.title: CVE-2026-137704 — IoT Security
item.description: Hard-coded administrator credentials in the D-Link DWM-222W LTE modem allow adjacent network attackers to extract plaintext passwords and fully compromise device management. This flaw severely weakens the security posture of consumer IoT networking hardware.

item.title: CVE-2026-133553 — Cloud Security
item.description: Container escape vulnerability allows shared writable volumes to overwrite host files via a race condition during tmpfs operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-137566 — Cloud Security
item.description: Path traversal in cloud storage artifact drivers permits writing malicious files outside intended bucket directories across S3, GCS, and Azure.

item.title: CVE-2026-137493 — Cloud Security
item.description: Authorization bypass allows anonymous users to access, modify, and delete entire base tables by manipulating view ID parameters.

item.title: CVE-2026-137963 — Cloud Security
item.description: Hardcoded cryptographic keys in Helm charts enable session token forgery and decryption of all stored datasource credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-110739 — Cloud Security
item.description: Google Cloud GKE Fleet's namespace onboarding API fails to restrict disallowed inputs, allowing authenticated attackers to escalate privileges to project owner level and compromise multi-tenant clusters.

item.title: CVE-2026-107935 — Cloud Security
item.description: Red Hat gvproxy network forwarder exposes an unauthenticated path traversal endpoint that can delete arbitrary host files, severely impacting confidential computing workloads in OpenShift environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-85258 — Cloud Security
item.description: Google Cloud Vertex AI's private console API lacks proper authorization checks, enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to enumerate, read, and manipulate other users' chat sessions.

item.title: CVE-2026-132890 — Cloud Security
item.description: Path traversal in the Eclipse Dataspace Components Vault extension permits cross-participant secret leakage in multi-tenant control planes. Attackers can bypass partition boundaries to access sensitive cryptographic material shared across cloud data exchanges.

item.title: CVE-2026-105917 — Cloud Security
item.description: Insecure file permissions in the Hitachi RV3000 Log Monitor for VMware expose sensitive virtual machine audit logs to unauthorized local users. This creates significant compliance and privacy risks in virtualized cloud environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-138004 — Network Devices
item.description: OS command injection via a manipulated UPnP SOAP argument allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on the router.

item.title: CVE-2026-135790 — Network Devices
item.description: Remote OS command injection in the dashboard chart dump endpoint; the exploit is public and actively being weaponized.

item.title: CVE-2026-137043 — Network Devices
item.description: Remote authorization bypass in the language configuration function allows unauthenticated administrative access to the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-137746 — Network Devices
item.description: Remote resource consumption vulnerability in the 5G core SMF component impacts network availability; exploit has been published.

item.title: CVE-2026-137721 — Network Devices
item.description: Mitel OpenScape suffers from command injection due to insufficient parameter sanitization, granting attackers full control over communication infrastructure devices.

item.title: CVE-2026-80485 — Network Devices
item.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition contains an OS command injection flaw exploitable by unauthenticated local attackers, potentially leading to complete gateway compromise.

item.title: CVE-2026-123761 — Network Devices
item.description: PowerDNS view processing logic errors can return incorrectly cached DNS records, undermining resolution integrity and potentially facilitating cache poisoning attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-137724 — Network Devices
item.description: Critical authentication mechanism failures in Mitel OpenScape 4000 Manager allow unauthenticated attackers to gain unauthorized access to sensitive telephony configurations. This directly jeopardizes enterprise voice communication infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-137723 — Network Devices
item.description: Insufficient parameter sanitization in Mitel OpenScape 4000 enables remote command injection, granting attackers full control over the underlying operating system. This flaw transforms standard VoIP management interfaces into persistent backdoors.

item.title: CVE-2026-80477 — Network Devices
item.description: SQL injection in Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition permits unauthenticated local attackers to manipulate backend databases and inject scripts. This compromises both data integrity and network perimeter security appliances.

item.title: CVE-2026-4642 — Industrial Control
item.description: ABB Relion Protection Relays contain incorrect authorization flaws that could allow unauthorized personnel to modify critical protection settings, risking industrial grid stability and safety.

item.title: CVE-2026-115283 — Industrial Control
item.description: Missing authentication controls in Hitachi Virtage firmware for BS2500/BS500 power systems allow unauthorized operators to modify critical grid configurations. This vulnerability directly threatens the operational stability of high-voltage DC infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-115284 — Industrial Control
item.description: Multiple missing authentication and denial-of-service flaws in Hitachi Virtage firmware collectively degrade the reliability and security of industrial power conversion equipment. Attackers can disrupt operations or alter settings without proper oversight.

item.title: CVE-2026-136115 — Web Security
item.description: Incorrect privilege assignment in the Discord addon allows privilege escalation within WordPress environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-136113 — Web Security
item.description: SQL injection in the WooCommerce payment gateway enables unauthorized database queries and sensitive data exfiltration.

item.title: CVE-2026-124266 — Web Security
item.description: Deserialization of untrusted data via object injection allows arbitrary code execution on compromised WordPress sites.

item.title: CVE-2026-137470 — Web Security
item.description: Stored cross-site scripting via block attributes enables persistent script injection in collaborative note-taking applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-134963 — Web Security
item.description: WPMasterToolKit allows arbitrary code injection through unvalidated inputs, posing a critical risk for widespread WordPress deployments relying on this toolkit.

item.title: CVE-2026-125812 — Web Security
item.description: WP Rocket's path traversal vulnerability enables attackers to read sensitive files outside restricted directories, compromising site confidentiality and integrity.

item.title: CVE-2026-134994 — Web Security
item.description: Nitramix Revertix deserializes untrusted data without safeguards, leading to object injection that can trigger remote code execution on affected WordPress sites.

item.title: CVE-2024-45801 — Web Security
item.description: DOMPurify can be bypassed using specially nested HTML structures, weakening client-side XSS mitigation across countless frontend applications and libraries.

item.title: CVE-2026-106125 — Web Security
item.description: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the Sneeit Framework WordPress plugin allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via exposed AJAX callbacks. This directly compromises thousands of websites running the vulnerable extension.

item.title: CVE-2026-137706 — Web Security
item.description: Missing authorization checks in Direk Tech Smart Portal enable authenticated users to arbitrarily add accounts to Active Directory Domain Admins groups. This flaw facilitates rapid privilege escalation and complete domain compromise.

item.title: CVE-2026-133941 — Web Security
item.description: Reflected cross-site scripting and missing CSRF tokens in JTL-Shop’s administration backend allow attackers to hijack administrative sessions and inject malicious payloads. This undermines e-commerce platform integrity and user trust.

item.title: CVE-2026-115867 — Web Security
item.description: Arbitrary file upload vulnerabilities in the CRMPerks WordPress plugin bypass extension validation, enabling direct web shell deployment on affected storefronts. Attackers can achieve persistent remote code execution on compromised servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-77230 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Insecure deserialization of Java-serialized web session attributes allows remote code execution in workflow management engines.

item.title: CVE-2026-137992 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Denial of service via crafted XML documents exploiting duplicate attribute declarations in internal DTD subsets.

item.title: CVE-2026-137684 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Authentication bypass in the SQL editor API allows unauthorized execution of database queries in AI-driven analytics platforms.

item.title: CVE-2026-114888 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Oracle Mobile Field Service Admin UI contains an easily exploitable vulnerability allowing low-privileged attackers to execute commands on the underlying middleware infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-137702 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Crafted SMTP traffic triggers a heap out-of-bounds write in Exim’s expansion code, risking remote code execution with root privileges. This flaw impacts mail relay infrastructure and message processing pipelines.

item.title: CVE-2024-7885 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Reusing a single StringBuilder instance across concurrent requests in Red Hat Undertow causes request data leakage between different HTTP connections. This breaks isolation guarantees in proxy and web server middleware.

item.title: CVE-2023-5685 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Excessive notifier state chaining in Red Hat XNIO triggers stack overflow exceptions, leading to denial of service in WildFly and JBoss deployments. This destabilizes enterprise application servers under heavy load.

item.title: CVE-2026-137539 — Other
item.description: Path traversal via crafted tar symlinks allows overwriting arbitrary files during automated package extraction processes.

item.title: CVE-2026-137998 — Other
item.description: Insecure deserialization in model checkpoint loading enables arbitrary code execution when the weights_only flag is disabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-137999 — Other
item.description: Code injection via unescaped JSON Schema default values breaks literal boundaries to execute arbitrary Python payloads.

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Other
item.description: Actively exploited in the wild per CISA KEV, the Google Brotli decoder buffer overflow allows memory corruption, information disclosure, and potential remote code execution across platforms.

item.title: CVE-2026-99362 — Other
item.description: The Linux kernel NFS daemon mishandles sequence replies, allowing malicious clients to manipulate cached reply limits and potentially cause denial of service or data leakage.

item.title: CVE-2026-137907 — Other
item.description: FFmpeg's boxblur filter accepts pixel formats deeper than supported, triggering a heap buffer overflow that can be abused via crafted media files to achieve arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-3640 — Other
item.description: Flaws in the Linux kernel’s CPU entry area mapping allow user-space processes to guess exception stack locations, potentially bypassing kernel memory protections. This requires immediate patching to maintain OS-level security boundaries.

item.title: CVE-2026-131871 — Other
item.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in the WLA DX linker parser executes arbitrary code when processing crafted object files with oversized namespaces. This compromises developer toolchains and build environment integrity.
